_comment: Reference copy of the deployment policy attached to GracefulGutAI-ClaudeDevRole.
<AWS_ACCOUNT_ID> is a placeholder. Substitute the real account ID at apply
time; it is deliberately not stored in this repository.
This copy is documentation only -- the dev role cannot modify IAM. Applying
FUNCTION URL ADMINISTRATION IS ADMINISTRATOR-ONLY. This role deliberately
a Function URL, or changing its AuthType, CORS configuration, or
resource-based policy, requires administrator credentials and is performed
outside this host. Those settings decide who can reach the function at all:
the resource policy grants Principal '*', and AuthType NONE is what makes
the endpoint anonymous, so the dev role must not be able to alter either.
Inspection is retained: lambda:GetFunctionUrlConfig reads the URL, AuthType,
and CORS settings, and lambda:GetPolicy reads the resource policy back. A
session can verify the configuration in full; it just cannot change it. See
